D: A young hunter is turned into a bear and travels with an orphaned cub to the place where the lights touch the earth.
P: Serve the mains when the bears gather at the salmon run.
S: the bears catching salmon at the salmon run
Rye crispbread spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, dill and a squeeze of lemon, laid out on a wooden board.
Koda leading Kenai through the forest
Blueberries, raspberries and blackberries tossed with a little honey, spooned into bowls over whipped cream.
Pecans and walnuts tossed with maple syrup and salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes and cooled into clusters.
M: Salmon fillets brushed with maple syrup and grainy mustard, roasted at 200C for 15 minutes, with dill-buttered baby potatoes.
Kenai's venison steaks with berry sauce
the hunt before Kenai becomes a bear
Pan-seared venison steaks with a quick blueberry and red wine sauce. Sear 4 venison steaks in a hot pan for 3 minutes a side and rest.
W: the honey and berries the bears love
Mixed berries tossed with honey under an oat, butter and brown sugar crumble, baked at 180C for 35 minutes, with cream.
K: the clear streams the bears drink from
Cold water in a big jug with cucumber ribbons, mint and plenty of ice.

s.note: the bears catching salmon at the salmon run
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with cream cheese. Top with folds of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Squeeze over a little lemon and lay them on a wooden board. Fresh from the salmon run.

Toss 150g pecans and 150g walnuts with 4 tbsp maple syrup and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool until set and break into clusters. Take off, eh, they are good.

m.n: Kenai's venison steaks with berry sauce
m.note: the hunt before Kenai becomes a bear
m.how: Sear 4 venison steaks in a hot pan for 3 minutes a side and rest. Add 150ml red wine, 150g blueberries and 1 tbsp brown sugar to the pan and simmer until syrupy. Serve with roast potatoes.

w.note: the honey and berries the bears love
w.how: Toss 500g mixed berries with 3 tbsp honey and spread in a dish. Rub 100g butter into oats, flour and 80g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until bubbling and serve with cream.

d.note: the clear streams the bears drink from
d.how: Fill a big jug with ice, cucumber ribbons and a handful of mint. Top up with cold water and leave for 10 minutes so the flavour comes through. Pour into glasses, clear and cold as a mountain stream.
